description: Use this skill at Step 0 of a hackathon build — BEFORE the architect — when the builder has a blank start and needs to go from "I want to build something for <hackathon>" to ONE scoped, shippable project idea. It diverges (generates many varied candidates), then converges on an external, event-tied weighted rubric to a single committed brief, and hands that brief to the architect in the exact format it ingests. Trigger it when the user says "help me come up with a hackathon idea", "what should I build for <hackathon>", "I need a project idea", "brainstorm hackathon ideas", "pick an idea for this hackathon", or shows up with a theme / sponsor tracks but no project yet. Do NOT use it once an idea is already chosen — that's the architect's job. The architect shapes an idea you have; this skill invents the idea you don't.
